title: Review: overnight range vs implied move -> takes the overnight high
body: CONFIRMED. No data leak (the implied move is priced at the previous close, the overnight range is known at the open). When the overnight range is small compared with what options price for the day, NY takes the overnight high 74% of the time vs 49% when it is large (base 65%), and this holds in 9/9 unseen years. It also adds real information on top of where the open sits in the overnight range: combining the two improves the forecast in 8 of 9 years. Use it as a tilt on top of the open position, not alone.

title: Weekly reflection (week of 26 Oct - 1 Nov 2026)
body: A quiet reading week: 8 papers entered the library, the most relevant being a study of the skewness premium on short-term exposure to squared market returns (relevance 4); none produced a testable edge. The test engine ran 57 ideas (engine_stats W44): 1 promising, 40 not confirmed, 1 unfit and 15 that failed translation - a 26% failure rate worth watching. The one survivor, Volta's own question pairing the options-implied move with the overnight range, was reviewed today and CONFIRMED: it adds information on top of the open's position in the overnight range in 8 of 9 unseen years. The strategy lab built 26 strategies and none passed; 21 of them were near-identical 'LowGamma/LowGex' combinations and 24 failed simply for having too few trades (often under 60 in ten years), so the generator is stuck in a corner - Volta should widen its filters or move to a different mechanism next week. No 'for Claude' wishes were open, so nothing was granted this week; the three open wishes all need Yannis (two family proposals that need an alpha slot, one intraday IV data feed).
